page: Microsoft Azure DC16ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DCadsv6 server family. It is powered by an AMD processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture and features 16 dedicated virtual CPUs. The system is provisioned with 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing a balanced allocation ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core. Virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server configuration includes 614 GB of local SSD storage and is designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing for integration with high-performance external storage volumes. It does not include any graphics processing units, as the GPU count is zero. Additionally, the instance does not bundle any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the DC16ads_v6 offers a balanced resource density suitable for workloads requiring dedicated CPU resources and local SSD capacity without the premium cost of GPU-accelerated or memory-optimized hardware classes. Appropriate workloads for this configuration include general-purpose applications, relational databases, web serving, and containerized microservices that benefit from local SSD storage and a 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio.
